description_en: Retrieves the information about a single audio or video file by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags
description_zh: 调用本接口通过音/视频ID来获取单个音视频的标题、描述、时长、封面URL、状态、创建时间、大小、截图、分类和标签等信息
name: GetVideoInfo

parameters.description_en:
The audio or video ID. Only one audio or video ID is supported. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the audio or video ID.
- Obtain the audio or video ID from the value of the VideoId response parameter when you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
- After the audio or video file is uploaded, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
音/视频ID，仅支持传入一个音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看音/视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
